async def act(page):
    # Locate the project name textbox
    project_name_textbox = page.get_by_role('textbox', name='Project name')
    
    # Get the current value of the textbox
    current_value = await project_name_textbox.input_value()
    
    # If the current value is not 'Title Wanted', fill it with 'Title Wanted'
    if current_value != 'Title Wanted':
        await project_name_textbox.fill('Title Wanted')
    
    # Click the Save changes button to save the project settings
    save_button = page.get_by_role('button', name='Save changes')
    await save_button.click()
    
    # Wait for the save operation to complete
    await page.wait_for_load_state('networkidle')
